name: Stage Manager
description:
macOS-style Stage Manager: keeps the active window group on stage and parks the other groups as live thumbnails on the left.

Groups are made of windows, not apps. Click a thumbnail to bring it on stage. Drag a thumbnail onto the stage (or Shift/Ctrl+click it) to add its windows to the current group; drag a window onto the strip to take just that window out. Middle-click splits a group. The strip hides while a window is close to it and comes back when the pointer touches the left edge; previews can be turned off in Quick Settings. Toggle Stage Manager with Super+Ctrl+S.
